messages:
sasha: Quick follow-up from the on‑prem packaging RFC — I sketched an alternative that trades seed size for resumable streaming + signed chunk manifests. want quick opinions before I fold into the doc.
kevin: short version: sounds good. how does operator UX look for a partial resume?
maria: +1 to resumability. main worry is operator confusion during a failed apply (partial activation state). need clear reconcile markers.
sasha: agreed. proposal: three activation states in manifest: pending, staged, active. operator shows progress until staged, then a short hold window (configurable) before active.
olivia: configurable hold window = nice. can we auto-fallback to previously active artifact if staged fails health checks?
sasha: yes — plan includes automatic rollback hook if post‑activation probes fail within hold window. fallback is a dual-image swap (apply new image, if fail swap back).
kevin: what about signature rotation and verifying chain if we resume mid‑stream? we can't reverify whole seed each time.
maria: we can verify each chunk independently with a chunk hash list signed by the release key. on resume you just fetch chunks not present and verify them individually against the list.
sasha: exact: manifest contains chunk index + sha256 per chunk + global manifest sig. resume fetches missing chunk ids and validates before write.
deploy-bot: automated-test: delta-stream resume test started for build #3421.
kevin: delta format question: do we prefer op-based deltas (patch ops) or binary chunk diffs? op-based is smaller but fragile for model artifacts.
maria: binary chunk diffs are safer for compressed blobs. op-based might be useful for small config files but not for large model weights.
olivia: agree. prefer chunk diffs + optional op patches for metadata. simplifies rollforward/rollback semantics.
sasha: another trade: indexing strategy. keep a lightweight bloom filter per chunk to quickly check presence? saves round trips but needs bloom maintenance.
ekevin: typo: (me) meant kevin :)
kevin: bloom seems OK for large fleets to reduce checks. but add versioned index to manifest so operator knows when an index changed.
maria: operator reconcile: state machine should expose last‑successful-chunk and current-target-chunk in status to make debugging easier. also emit a compact trace (chunk ids + errors) to logs.
sasha: UX: console shows a progress bar and "resume" button if network interrupted. resume button triggers fetch of missing chunk list and resumes apply.
olivia: can we expose a dry‑run mode to validate chunks & signatures without writing? helpful for preflight in airgapped ops.
sasha: yes, dry-run exists in my sketch. command: `redwood-upgrade --dry-run --manifest /tmp/m.json` returns chunk summary + missing IDs + sig check.
maria: tests needed: corrupt-chunk detection, midstream powercut, manifest rekey mismatch, and rollback race between staged and operator manual revert.
ekevin: deploy-bot: can we add CI job that simulates flaky network and validates resume + rollback?
deploy-bot: CI job "airgap-resume-flaky-net" queued (eta 45m).
kevin: security note: ensure manifest signature algorithm is forward compatible (support ed25519 + rsa). some enterprise keys are in HSM RSA only.
sasha: right — manifest supports multiple sig entries; operator tries all known keys in keyring. also plan for sig-escrow for emergency rekeying flow.
maria: doc followups: add operator API for listing active artifacts, staged artifacts, and fallback triggers. also include sample log snippets for common failures.
olivia: small nit: mention disk pressure strategy — stream-to-temp then swap to active path to avoid half-written files consuming final path.
sasha: yep temp staging dir then atomic rename. added.
kevin: sounds actionable. next steps: sasha updates RFC with chunk manifest schema + state machine + sample CLI. I'll carve out tests with deploy-bot.
sasha: thanks — I'll push draft updates tonight and ping everyone. @olivia @maria if you can skim the manifest schema when I post. :thumbsup:
olivia: will do.
maria: ack.
deploy-bot: message: RFC update pushed to https://internal.redwood/rfcs/airgap-chunked-stream — build tests running."
